BiblicalUsage: A guard is the armed watch at a post, and the word appears twice: the Philistines challenge Jonathan to come up to them where the guard stands, and the LORD promises to encamp about His house because of the army.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two verses belong together: men set a guard to keep others out, and God sets His own guard to keep His people safe.
